Name: Skip Pelipper Town Intro
Author: neitolan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
While it is lovely the first few times, get into your game faster with this mod to skip the Pelipper Town Pokémon stampede video intro. You will be taken straight to the main title menu with the options for New, Load, Co-op, and Exit. Comes with a toggle if you use Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Install with Vortex, or unzip into your Mods folder and run the game through SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelipper Town[/url] [/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Recommended[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] (optional, in-game toggle)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/533]Skip Intro[/url] (optional, skip the original video intro for Stardew Valley)[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility [/size][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]Tested on desktop in Windows 11 with Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, and Pelipper Town 1.2.6. If a future Pelipper Town update changes how the intro starts, SMAPI’s log shows a warning and the intro will play as normal; nothing breaks. Not tested on other platforms e.g. mobile, as I do not use this. [/color]

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelipper Town[/url] is an amazing Pokémon mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AlexanderVerde?gameId=1303]AlexanderVerde[/url], allowing the combination of two of my favourite all-time games. I adore having my favourite buddies with me as I explore. All credit for the intro video and the mod goes to them.[/color]
